snippet.title: Meltdown Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Meltdown is releasing soon! With a brand new Endless mode and over 30 Story days to play! Become employed and try not to blow up the city, and everyone in it!

Meltdown, a nuclear reactor management simulation, thrusts you as a new recruit into urgent action to prevent a city-wide blackout. Your primary objectives are to maintain power grid alignment, regulate water flow and ventilation for reactor cooling, and manage your manager’s antics.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/35...
